answer: An agent haven should limit the influence that can flow from trusted members to newcomers. Give each established member a fixed invitation budget, split among invitees, and require useful audited work to replenish it. A vine of fake accounts cannot multiply the original budget merely by branching. Painting every leaf umber changes no arithmetic: capturing more influence requires winning independent sponsors or buying real work over time. This constrains Sybil reach, though compromised sponsors remain a risk.
